text: Ben maɓɓe maakani ɓe: Mi immindintaa mo e mooɗon haa ƴettanon mi ahadi ka Alla, wonnde pellet on artiranay lam mo si wanaa hara maayde huɓindi on fow mon, hara alah heddiiɗo e mon, on ronku feere haɗugol ɗum. Ɓaawo ɓe ƴettanii mo ahdi Alla fellintinaandi e ɗum ndin, o maaki: Alla ko seediiɗo e ko wowluɗen kon, seedee Makko on yonii en.
